name: opc-studio-electron
author: OPC Studio Contributors
_stagingNote: `server-bundle/` is produced by the repo-root `build:electron` script (pnpm deploy of @opc/server — a self-contained dist + node_modules incl. @opc/shared/dist). Do NOT run `dist:win` standalone; run root `pnpm build:electron`, which stages before invoking electron-builder. Electron/electron-builder come from the REPO ROOT devDependencies (single source of truth — this package deliberately has no devDependencies and is not a pnpm workspace member; root `pnpm run` puts the root .bin on PATH). Keep `build.electronVersion` in lockstep with the root `electron` version.
